attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The day's line enumerates all seven brothers by name, so it is one folder each, and the page gives each of them a couplet of his own besides. Orentius the corpus already keeps from the Romanian calendar of the same day, where doxologia.ro printed his name and no life; the six others arrive here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
